title: Goldfeld’s conjecture: densities and mean analytic rank

result.label: Goldfeld’s conjecture: densities and mean analytic rank
result.statement: Proves Goldfeld's conjecture for quadratic twists of every elliptic curve over ℚ: analytic ranks zero and one each have density 1/2, and the mean analytic rank tends to 1/2. Both statements order signed squarefree twist parameters by absolute value.
result.roleNote: The family's stated result in the release.
